text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For the Arima Kinen that would cap off 
Eishin Flash's three years, both seniors 
and juniors gathered—an Umamusume lineup 
worthy of the "strongest era."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she takes 1st place today, she can end 
her career on the highest note possible. 
As Eishin Flash says this, her Trainer 
tells her to hold on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although the schedule handed over from 
today onward was sloppy, there was an 
unmistakable passion to see Eishin Flash 
keep running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Eishin Flash had already resolved 
within herself that she "wanted to keep 
running"— and smiled, planning to readjust 
her schedule after the race.
